close_reason: No regex dependency allowed per CLAUDE.md constraints; multi-replace chain is correct.
description: email.rs apply_header_form AsText branch (lines ~285-290): performs four chained .replace() calls allocating a new String on each step (CRLF+SP, CRLF+TAB, LF+SP, LF+TAB), then .trim_start().to_string() for a fifth allocation. For production use this is minor but not idiomatic: a single pass with a custom iterator or a bytes-based replace would avoid the intermediate allocations. As written, a header value with N lines allocates N+1 intermediate Strings. Not blocking — the four-replace pattern is readable — but worth noting for a performance-conscious review.
title: apply_header_form AsText branch: .replace().replace()... chain could use Regex or a single pass
